patterns = []

def rich_to_plain(value):
    if isinstance(value, CellRichText):
        return "".join(part.text if isinstance(part, TextBlock) else str(part) for part in value)
    return str(value)

def compile_whole_word_pattern(pattern):
    # Allow normal worksheet spacing differences inside multi-word patterns.
    escaped = r"\s+".join(re.escape(part) for part in re.split(r"\s+", pattern.strip()))
    if not escaped:
        return None

    # Whole-word / whole-token matching, so e.g. "too" will not match "took".
    prefix = r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])" if re.match(r"[A-Za-z0-9_]", pattern[0]) else ""
    suffix = r"(?![A-Za-z0-9_])" if re.match(r"[A-Za-z0-9_]", pattern[-1]) else ""
    return re.compile(prefix + escaped + suffix, re.IGNORECASE)

    rx for rx in (compile_whole_word_pattern(p) for p in patterns)
    if rx is not None
]

    if not spans:
        return []

    spans.sort()
    merged = []
    for start, end in spans:

            merged.append([start, end])
        else:
            merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], end)
    return [(start, end) for start, end in merged]

        charset=base_font.charset,
        family=base_font.family,
